messages.subject: Internationalisation of data tables
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to change datatables' language to French. This seems possible (http://www.datatables.net/manual/i18n), but I'm unsure how to do it in shiny (I really suck at javascript). I tried several possibilities but without any success yet. Any hint?

Thanks!

Joel

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Internationalisation of data tables
parts:
Just "translate" the JavaScript object to an R list, e.g.

renderDataTable(..., options = list(
language = list(
search = "Search/French..."
)
))

Regards,
Yihui
